_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Surround ka {width}x{height} grid.
O le {player_id}-player. Ditshwanelo tse amanang le mekgwa: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' gape o ka sebedisa w/s/a/d.
Mmušo: O tshwanetse go phela go sa felele batho ba bangwe. Ditsheko di sa tshwane; go kgona lekgoro go robala; go kgona ka moja-moja go robala ba babedi.

board.after_moves: Lekgotla ka morago ga go sepela gotee: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Sebapadi {player_id} o hwile ka baka la mosepelo wo sa swanelago.

outcome.survived_win: Sebapadi {player_id} se ile sa phologa; ba bangwe ka moka ba ile ba wa.
outcome.all_crashed: Bapetšhi ka moka ba ile ba wa ka nako e tee.
outcome.outlived: Sebapadi se phetše nako e telele go feta ba bangwe ka moka.
outcome.turn_limit: Go fihlelelwa ga mollwane wa go retologa - mophološi yo a phelago nako e telele o a fenya.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Tlhokomelo ya kgale ya dikgoro (e kgone go ya go e ntle): {groups}
